newsitem.title: UK: LME copper dips in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper dips in late trading.

text.p: LME copper dipped in late inter-office trading on Friday but then stabilised.

Three month copper quotes slid as low as $1937/42 per tonne in after-hours activity from a kerb close of $1,957 after earlier failing to sustain a rally over the key $1,970 resistance level on profit-taking.
By 1800 GMT, prices had rebounded slightly but settled below the $1,950 barrier at $1,943/47.
Aluminium and the other metals were little changed.
